predicate.label: lawyer or attorney for
predicate.definition: Person X serves or served as attorney, lawyer or legal counsel for client, employer, organization or governmental jurisdiction Y.
includes: explicit lawyer/attorney/counsel for/at/with client or employer
explicit governmental attorney office for a jurisdiction
excludes: private lawyer merely located in a city
ambiguous: city as location versus represented jurisdiction
firm partner without a clear legal-role attachment
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: explicit lawyer/attorney/counsel for/at/with client or employer; legal employment at a firm; explicit governmental attorney office for a jurisdiction. Excludes: private lawyer merely located in a city; spokesperson/director/lobbyist alone; reverse client-to-lawyer direction. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: city as location versus represented jurisdiction; firm partner without a clear legal-role attachment.

rationale: Attorney title overwhelmingly dominates; jurisdiction-role noun modifiers require case-level distinction from private geographic location, and nominations are not tenure.
